reason: Butler National is mainly an aerospace holding company (FAA-approved aircraft modifications, avionics, defense electronics) with a smaller gaming management segment, the Boot Hill Casino. Accel runs slot machines and video gaming terminals in bars, restaurants and truck stops. Accel overlaps only with Butler's gaming segment, and even there it differs. Butler manages a single casino, while Accel operates a route of terminals. Both serve gaming patrons and are heavily regulated by state gaming authorities. Accel has no overlap with the aerospace business, so the score is capped at 1.
